name: Persistent Memory Poisoning
description: Injection of adversarial content into an agent's durable memory (long-term memory stores, user profiles, episodic memory, learned preferences) so that it influences future sessions without a fresh injection.
differs: Distinguished from RAG Poisoning (T2.001) by the durable-state attack surface: the poisoned artifact lives in the agent's own memory and persists across sessions and users, so the blast radius and remediation differ (memory purge vs. index clean-up).
